courses.title: KS2 Maths Foundations
courses.subject: Maths
courses.summary: Number confidence, times tables and problem solving for Years 3-6.
courses.description: Small-group and one-to-one sessions that rebuild number confidence from the ground up. We work through the KS2 national curriculum at the pace the child needs, with plenty of practical apparatus and low-stakes practice.

courses.title: KS3 Maths (Years 7-9)
courses.subject: Maths
courses.summary: Bridging primary arithmetic into algebra, ratio and geometry.
courses.description: The KS3 years are where gaps quietly open up before GCSE. This course covers the full Year 7-9 programme of study, with diagnostic checks each half term so we can go back over anything that has not stuck.
topics: Negative numbers and order of operations
Angles in parallel lines and polygons

courses.title: KS3 Science (Years 7-9)
courses.subject: Science
courses.summary: Biology, chemistry and physics fundamentals with practical investigation skills.
courses.description: A single course covering all three sciences at KS3, with an emphasis on working scientifically: variables, fair tests, graphs and conclusions. Ideal preparation for setting decisions at the end of Year 9.
topics: Particle model and states of matter

courses.title: GCSE Combined Science (Trilogy)
courses.subject: Science
courses.summary: Biology, chemistry and physics content plus the required practicals.
courses.description: Covers the combined science specification including all required practicals and the maths skills that appear in the papers. We rotate across the three sciences so nothing is left until the last term.
topics: Atomic structure and the periodic table
Rates of reaction and organic chemistry

courses.title: GCSE Maths (Higher Tier)
courses.subject: Maths
courses.summary: Full Higher tier coverage with exam technique for grades 6-9.
courses.description: Complete Higher tier coverage across all exam boards, including the topics that decide grades 7-9: surds, algebraic fractions, circle theorems, vectors and iterative methods. Past paper questions every session.
topics: Quadratics: factorising, formula, completing the square

courses.title: A Level Maths
courses.subject: Maths
courses.summary: Pure, statistics and mechanics across Years 12 and 13.
courses.description: Year 12 and Year 13 content taught alongside school, with a focus on the proof and modelling skills that students find hardest in the transition from GCSE. Includes support for the large data set.
topics: Statistical sampling and the large data set
